title: VASP MnF2: bands of a collinear antiferromagnet
summary: Rutile MnF2, collinear antiferromagnet, from a spin-polarized VASP run: the PAO Hamiltonian (Mn 3P 3D 4S 4P 4D 4F, F 2P 3S 3P 3D 4S) and the up and down band structures. Needs your own VASP runs and POTCAR.

steps.label: MnF2 spin-polarized bands
steps.note: needs the VASP runs of nscf/ (vasprun.xml, WAVECAR, POTCAR); writes output/ and MnF2_VASP.png
